ex.2: MBT = 330 + 350 − 360 = 320, so the aircraft is on the 140 radial (the book's OBS works out to 136, reverse sensing).
ex.9: Turn 10° off and rotate the OBS 10°: an isosceles triangle, so the time to the station equals the time flown, 8 min; heading to the station 260°.
ex.25: QDM = 230 + 040 = 270, so the bearing from the NDB is 090.
ex.27: RB = 090 − 225 + 360 = 225: a quadrantal bearing, so the error is at its maximum.
ex.33: The QDM falls from 060 to 057 while the heading stays 055: the station moves left, so the aircraft is drifting right (starboard).
